name: Camp
description: Your clearing beneath the canopy. Rest, prepare supplies and craft a fishing rod.

name: Riverbank
description: Follow the stream for drinking water, dry branches, fibers and worms for bait.

name: Fishing Pond
description: A quiet pool beyond the river. Bring a Basic Rod and bait, then watch for a bite.

name: Plane Wreck
description: Search the broken aircraft for supplies and the working parts of a rescue radio.

name: Ancient Ruins
description: Cut through the dense trail and align the old stone seal. A survey cache lies beneath the altar.

name: Bamboo Grove
description: A sunlit grove of hollow stems and young shoots. A blade helps with the thickest canes.

name: Mangrove Shallows
description: Still water hides between tangled roots. Search the dry banks and watch what moves below the surface.
